fields.works: Stotra-ratna (translated by Kuśakratha dāsa, in this record)
fields.notes: The guru (parama-guru) of Rāmānuja and a great exponent of Viśiṣṭādvaita, also called Āḷavandār; some verses of his Stotra-ratna were accepted with great respect by the Gauḍīya Gosvāmīs. The record «Yāmunācārya's Stotra-ratna» #1782 (the translation of the book) was joined to this one (07-11-2026, Whisper).
